faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Aniimo.

items.question: What is Aniimo?
items.answer: Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world action RPG developed by Pawprint Studio and published by FunPlus. As a Pathfinder, you explore the continent of Idyll, bond with magical creatures via the Twine system, and wield their abilities in real-time combat and co-op quests.

items.question: What platforms is Aniimo on?
items.answer: Aniimo is coming to PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and mobile (iOS and Android). It is a multi-platform release, not a Roblox game.

items.question: What is the Twine system in Aniimo?
items.answer: Twine is Aniimo's core bonding mechanic. Instead of capturing creatures, you forge a bond that lets you sync with them, see through their eyes, and directly control their unique abilities in real-time combat and exploration.

items.question: Is Aniimo free to play?
items.answer: Yes, Aniimo is officially confirmed as a free-to-play game across PC, console, and mobile, with optional in-game purchases. The full release is planned for 2026.

items.question: When does Aniimo release?
items.answer: Aniimo is planned for a full global release in 2026 and is currently in Global Closed Beta with pre-registration open. An exact release date has not yet been announced.

gameInfo.title: What is Aniimo?
paragraphs: Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world action RPG developed by Pawprint Studio and published by FunPlus. As a Pathfinder, you explore the vibrant continent of Idyll, bond with magical creatures via the Twine system, see through their eyes, and wield their abilities in real-time combat and co-op fantasy quests.

The game was first revealed at the 2025 Xbox Games Showcase and is considered a major contender in the open-world creature-catching genre. A full global release is planned for 2026, with Global Closed Beta and pre-registration already underway and over 5 million pre-registrations.
